## History

Katie Maurice was an imaginary friend represented by a young girl's reflection in a bookcase glass door. She was imagined to be another little girl who lived inside the bookcase.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--katie-maurice.md)

Katie Maurice is [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's imaginary friend, existing as Anne's reflection in the glass door of a bookcase. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) used the reflection to comfort herself during her lonely childhood before coming to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), speaking to Katie as if she were a real person who shared her thoughts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

- presumed Friend of — imaginary friend and reflection in a bookcase door  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)</sub>
